title: Mouse Without Borders Portable 1.0.1-rc.1
summary: Release candidate for essential reliability fixes. One self-contained EXE; use the same RC on both PCs. Windows automated checks gate publication; real two-PC testing is requested before any stable release.
changes: Validated, atomic preference saves with a last-known-good backup and explicit recovery instead of silently resetting configuration.
Manual and generated keys are saved before activation; option changes are saved consistently and Exit attempts a bounded final save.
Local clipboard/settings RPC permissions are restricted to the current Windows account.
Safer installation rollback, preserved source preferences during migration, and ownership checks before removing shortcuts.
Bounded helper shutdown and normal process priority instead of Windows RealTime priority.
Release version and executable version must match; published assets cannot be silently replaced.
testing: Exit MWB on both PCs. Keep copies of the old EXE and adjacent MouseWithoutBorders.prefs.json. Replace only the EXE and run this RC on both PCs; confirm About says 1.0.1-rc.1 and the existing key/layout remain.
Move the mouse between PCs, click/drag, type, and use your usual shortcuts. Check ordinary responsiveness while copying a file.
Copy text and an image in both directions. Copy hello, then HELLO, and confirm the second text arrives correctly.

Transfer a disposable small file and a large file in both directions, using your usual copy/paste and drag/drop. Confirm contents and sizes; interrupt a disposable transfer by disconnecting Wi-Fi, reconnect, then transfer again.
Change an option such as Draw mouse cursor, exit immediately, reopen, and confirm it stayed changed. Restore your preferred setting.
If comfortable re-pairing, generate a new key, put it on the other PC, then restart both and confirm reconnection. Four-character custom keys remain supported.
Lock/unlock and sleep/wake the PCs, then check mouse and clipboard again. Exit and restart several times and confirm no stuck tray process prevents reopening.
Optional: try first launch/install in a separate test folder with copied preferences. Recovery/corruption tests should use copies only; ordinary testing does not require editing JSON.
known_limitations: No new transfer progress window, resume support, folder-to-folder drop targeting, or Wi-Fi prioritization is included.
Additional audit follow-ups remain: transfer policy enforcement, destination-name collisions, and stronger IPC connection lifecycle recovery. Use disposable transfer files in this RC.
